how: We read the website of every Detroit wedding planner listed on Lazo (121 listings, 93 sites reachable) and set aside the ones that are not really in the wedding business: an officiant, a bridal boutique, venues and DJs that also sell coordination, decorators we list under florists, and a site still showing template placeholder text. What is left is a shortlist of vendors who say clearly what they do, show their work, and tell you how they work. Verified Lazo vendors come first. Nobody paid to be here, and this is not a ranking: Lazo ranks only on reviews from couples who booked.
ask: Full planning, partial, or day-of only? Ask what each tier includes in hours and in meetings.
Which Metro Detroit venues have you run a wedding at this year, and do you know their winter load-in and parking rules?
Who is on site on the wedding day, the planner I hired or an associate?

picks.name: Touch Of Elegance Events & Designs
picks.blurb: Created in Detroit in 2014, Touch of Elegance offers full-service wedding planning, month-of coordination and custom wedding design. The team says it set out to build a process so couples savor every moment up to the aisle, and the site shows wedding stories and client words.

picks.name: Color Me Fancy Events
picks.blurb: Ericka founded Color Me Fancy Events for Metro Detroit brides who want a calm, organized, elevated wedding day without managing every detail themselves. Services run from full planning to wedding day coordination, with styling, balloons and officiant services available. Garden City.

picks.name: Marigold Wedding Planners
picks.blurb: Sisters Tina and Nitty lead Marigold Wedding Planners, a South Asian wedding planning company working in Michigan and New Jersey and across the Midwest and Northeast. Planning, event design and cultural integration are handled together. Novi-based.

picks.name: Fear No More Wedding Planning
picks.blurb: Fear No More Events plans sophisticated weddings through creative design, detailed logistics and problem-solving, written for the busy professional with no time to build a dream wedding alone. The planner says she thrives in situations that would cause most to panic. Plymouth.

picks.name: V Agency
picks.blurb: Fifteen years of expertise in refined design and flawless execution, curated for cosmopolitan couples seeking exclusive, tailored weddings, is how V Agency in Detroit describes itself. From initial vision to final farewell, with what it calls distinguished vendor partnerships.

picks.name: Krystina Lynn Wedding and Event Design
picks.blurb: Krystina Lynn is a Detroit-based planner, out of Ferndale, who started learning the business behind the scenes at a young age and now specializes in luxury, personalized weddings. Full-service planning and event coordination are both offered, for a sleek city wedding or something less usual.

picks.name: Beautiful Day Planning
picks.blurb: Founded in January 2009, BDP has grown into one of the larger wedding and event planning and design companies in Metro Detroit, by its own account, with industry awards and features in wedding publications. An extensive network of preferred vendors offers its clients discounts and add-ons. Rochester Hills.

picks.name: Blushing Rose Events
picks.blurb: Devona runs Blushing Rose Events as an event production company with a team of designers and production staff, after friends and family kept asking her to run their events. Her comprehensive service covers planning and design guidance through the entire process, and she brings a master's degree to the work. Bloomfield Township.

picks.name: Everlasting Engagements
picks.blurb: You planned it, we'll ensure it happens, is the wedding day management pitch from Everlasting Engagements in Bloomfield Hills: coordinating vendors, timeline and logistics, running the rehearsal and the day. Decor rental and design are offered alongside planning, and the owner's story starts with setting the table for grandma.

picks.name: Your Perfectly Planned Occasion
picks.blurb: Laurie Kort, owner and executive event director, is a mother of five and grandmother of five who says she is nearly addicted to the look in a bride's eyes on the day. The Ruby package is wedding day management, so you enjoy the day with family and friends and leave the rest to her team. Farmington Hills.

picks.name: Utsav Planners, Inc.
picks.blurb: Rupali Bedi founded Utsav Planners in 2005, and the Livonia team provides event planning, decorating and management for weddings across Michigan and neighboring areas. Packages combine services, including one for the couple who wants a professional to manage the whole planning process.

picks.name: Miraj Events
picks.blurb: Mehreen of Miraj Events brings over a decade of hands-on event coordination, from community gatherings and corporate functions before turning to luxury weddings. Full-service planning, partial planning and day-of coordination are laid out as three tiers. Sterling Heights.
